host_difference.observation: Both reused-list and new-list paths explicitly resign the editor first responder before showing the sidebar. No keyboard snapshot coordinator is wired.

decision: Do not only remove resignFirstResponder: establish snapshot capture, placement in translated content surface, and focus/selection restoration on close first.
next_minimal_evidence: Trace KeyboardSnapshotSession creation/disposal from coordinator, including enabled-state gate.
Bind restorationState variants and their calls to editor/keyboard owner.
limits: Screenshot only establishes visible keyboard pixels, not whether a live keyboard or snapshot.
Snapshot layer/source and animation synchronization remain unresolved.
